title: School completion, Eastern and South-eastern Asia, by wealth
headline: 11 of 16 countries in E. and S.-E. Asia have data on primary completion; for 5, nothing after 2020
subtitle: Percentage of a cohort of children or young people aged 3-5 years above the intended age for the last grade of primary education who have completed primary education
years: E. and S.-E. Asia: latest values 2012 to 2023; median year 2021.
data_line: Data: UNESCO UIS via UN SDG Global Database, series SE_TOT_CPLR, extracted 1 Nov 2026
alt: 11 of 16 countries in E. and S.-E. Asia have data on primary completion; for 5, nothing after 2020. E. and S.-E. Asia: latest values 2012 to 2023; median year 2021. Countries in Eastern and South-eastern Asia by year of their latest value on primary completion: 11 in all, 5 in 2020 or earlier.
method: Method: latest value per country; 2020 or earlier is not recent.
question: Which countries have found a way to measure primary completion more often, and what made it possible?
